renderings.kjv: things made ready to our hand

elsewhere.note: Again he sent out other servants, saying, ‘Tell those who are invited, “Behold, I have prepared my dinner. My cattle and my fatlings are killed, and all things…
He will himself show you a large upper room furnished and ready. Get ready for us there.”
Therefore be ready also, for the Son of Man is coming in an hour that you don’t expect him.”
Jesus therefore said to them, “My time has not yet come, but your time is always ready.
Now therefore, you with the council inform the commanding officer that he should bring him down to you tomorrow, as though you were going to judge his case…
I thought it necessary therefore to entreat the brothers that they would go before to you and arrange ahead of time the generous gift that you promised before…
Remind them to be in subjection to rulers and to authorities, to be obedient, to be ready for every good work,
who by the power of God are guarded through faith for a salvation ready to be revealed in the last time.
